title: Referee.chat — An AI Panel Works Your Goal, a Referee Rules
excerpt: State a goal and the bar it has to clear. A panel of up to six AI models works it out; a referee rules on every criterion using cited sources and executed code.
content_html:
Evidence, not opinions

Every seat searches the literature on arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref and Europe PMC, reads the sources, and runs Python to check arithmetic instead of asserting it. A claim with nothing re-checkable behind it cannot settle a criterion.

Stuck is a move, not a failure

When a seat hits a wall it stops and hands one specific question to whichever seat is best placed to answer it — with just that question, not the whole history. Cheaper than letting a model thrash, and it usually unblocks.

Long goals survive

Everything established goes in a shared ledger, so nothing is re-derived and nothing is forgotten. Matches pause and resume without losing work — close the tab and come back tomorrow.

content_html_zh:
证据，而不是观点

每个席位都会搜索 arXiv、OpenAlex、Crossref 和 Europe PMC 上的文献，阅读源代码，并运行 Python 来检查算术而不是断言它。 背后没有任何可重新检查的主张无法确定标准。

陷入困境是一种行动，而不是失败

当一个座位撞到墙上时，它会停下来，并将一个具体问题交给最适合回答该问题的座位——只提出这个问题，而不是整个历史。 比让模型摔跤更便宜，而且通常会解锁。

长期目标得以生存

建立的所有内容都保存在共享账本中，因此不会重新派生任何内容，也不会忘记任何内容。 比赛暂停和恢复，不会丢失工作 - 关闭选项卡，明天再回来。
